requirements.rule: ANNUAL MINIMI: the minimi of the CCNL are updated every year from 1 January by the Commissione nazionale (Art. 38, ISTAT variation of the consumer prices); the bundle holds the table of 2026. From 1 January 2027 the amounts are those of 2026 until the 2027 table is published and added, so a 2027 run is not payable.
requirements.remediation: Add the minimi of 2027 set by the Commissione nazionale with their source, then remove this note.

requirements.rule: NOT MODELLED: students aged 16 to 40 (art. 14 c. 2) at levels other than C, B and B super, for whom Tabella B has no value. The 2026 monthly allowances of Tables H (BS, 97.06) and L (B and BS, 30.27) are encoded for caller-attested eligible roles; child age, certification validity and absorption by better individual pay cannot be inferred from the role alone.
requirements.remediation: Source the Tabella B values for the other student levels. For modeled levels, supply eligible roles only after checking child age, certification conditions and any offset against individual pay.
